alerts.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 14 at 10:03PM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 24 to 30 possible. Lower
valleys may drop to 20.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
alerts.areaDesc: Lower Yampa River Basin; Central Yampa River Basin; Upper Yampa River Basin; Central Colorado River Basin; San Juan River Basin

alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 14 at 5:58PM MDT until October 15 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected above 9500 feet. Total snow accumulations
between 4 and 8 inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Elkhead and Park Mountains, Flat Tops, Gore and Elk
Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys, Grand and Battlement Mesas, and
West Elk and Sawatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could become slippery at times due to slushy
conditions over mountain passes.
alerts.areaDesc: Elkhead and Park Mountains; Grand and Battlement Mesas; Gore and Elk Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys; West Elk and Sawatch Mountains; Flat Tops

alerts.title: US 40 Milner Resurfacing-147529
alerts.description: Between Down Hill Drive (near Steamboat Springs) and County Road 29 (5 miles west of the Hayden area) from Mile Point 128.8 to Mile Point 100.5. Road construction. Starting October 16, 2026 at 8:30AM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 16, 8:30AM - October 16, 7:00PM Comment: Alternating one-lane traffic as the project completes shouldering , rumble strips and final striping. Ten to 15 minute delays should be expected. The project is 14-miles of resurfacing along US Highway 40 through Milner. Paving work will take place from the Xcel Energy Hayden station, Mile Point 112, to about five miles west of Steamboat Springs, MP 126.Additional work includes guardrail replacement, minor improvements and safety enhancements on three bridges and slope stabilization. The project is expected to be completed by the middle of November.
